title: [Lev 9] Comparison and disposition across Jev, Kev, and Lev
body:
Part of #9345. Depends on #9352.

Score Lev against Kev and hosted Jev on the same items, through the same contract, and publish the result.

All three implementations speak `POST /v1/systemone`, so one harness pointed at three base URLs produces the comparison. Items are in-repo.

## What to build

- A comparison harness that runs one suite against a `jev` client configured for each of the three doors.
- A card in `docs/lev/` with accuracy, calibration, mechanism, and runtime numbers, and the failures recorded rather than omitted.

## Acceptance

- One table, same items, three columns.
- A written disposition: which workloads Lev is admitted for, which it is refused for, and what would change the answer. A clear no is a successful outcome.
- `docs/lev/README.md`'s status line updated to match reality.
